You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. Rear camera with washer - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now!  With brake assist, you will.  It uses the speed of the brake pedals travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one. Predictive brake assist - Be prepared for your big brake. Predictive brake assist monitors the available distance in front of you compared to your vehicles speed.  If your speed exceeds the required distance to stop short of a collision, it readies your brakes to apply maximum stopping force when you use them. description: Crystal White Tricoat on 24-inch split 6-spoke alloys, with a Sheer Gray and Jet Black interior  a lighter, more striking combination than the black-on-black most V-Series trucks wear. This 2025 Cadillac Escalade V-Series is a CARFAX One-Owner vehicle, priced below KBB Fair Purchase Price with an odometer reading 6,239 miles below market average. The hand-assembled supercharged 6.2L V8 produces 682 horsepower and 653 lb-ft of torque through a 10-speed automatic and all-wheel drive, riding on Magnetic Ride Control paired with Air Ride Adaptive Suspension and an electronic limited-slip differential. EPA estimates come in at 11 MPG city and 17 MPG highway, which nobody shopping this vehicle is surprised by.  The cabin is the most elaborate Cadillac builds. Full semi-aniline leather with faceted quilting covers heated and ventilated front seats with power lumbar massage, set against Platinum interior trim. Next Generation Active Noise Cancellation keeps the cabin quiet at speed, power open/close doors and soft-closing front and rear doors handle themselves, a power panoramic tilt-sliding sunroof opens the roof, and power-retractable assist steps deploy on approach beneath illuminating front and rear sill plates. The Interior Protection Package adds all-weather floor mats for all three rows and an integrated cargo liner.  The AKG Studio Reference 36-speaker audio system remains one of the genuinely remarkable factory setups at any price, joined by a rear seat entertainment system, a reconfigurable full-color head-up display, and Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. Night Vision leads the driver-assistance content alongside a rear parking camera. For towing, an integrated trailer brake controller, Hitch Guidance with Hitch View, Blind Zone Steering Assist with Trailering, the Trailering App, trailering assist guidelines, and a Smart Trailer Integration Indicator are all on board. Security runs deep with a theft-deterrent alarm system backed by glass breakage, vehicle inclination, and interior movement sensors plus door lock and latch shields. description: A luxury crossover earns its place by making everyday driving feel easier, quieter, and more comfortable, and this 2012 Lexus RX 350 still delivers that formula with a refined V6, all-wheel drive, leather seating, and the relaxed road manners that made the RX one of the defining premium SUVs of its era. Finished in Cerulean Blue Metallic, it has a clean, understated presence that suits everything from daily driving around Wesley Chapel to longer trips across Tampa Bay.  Power comes from Lexuss 3.5-liter V6 paired with a six-speed automatic transmission with Sequential Shift control. The naturally aspirated V6 delivers smooth, predictable power without relying on turbocharging, while the all-wheel-drive system adds useful traction when Florida rain turns roads slick or when a trip takes you beyond perfectly dry pavement. The RX is tuned more for quiet confidence than aggressive sportiness, making it a comfortable choice for commuting, highway travel, and everyday errands.  Inside, leather seating gives the cabin the upscale feel buyers expect from Lexus. The RX was designed around comfort and simplicity, with supportive seating, a well-organized dashboard, dual-zone automatic climate control, push-button start, power accessories, and a quiet cabin layout that helps reduce fatigue on longer drives. The elevated seating position gives the driver a clear view of surrounding traffic without the bulk of a full-size SUV.  The second row is especially useful because it combines adult-friendly passenger room with practical cargo flexibility. The rear seat can slide, recline, and fold to make room for luggage, groceries, golf bags, family gear, or larger items. The rear cargo area is broad and easy to access, so the RX works well for airport runs, shopping around New Tampa, or loading up for a weekend toward Clearwater without feeling oversized in parking lots.  Technology is intentionally straightforward by modern standards. Steering-wheel controls place common audio and driver functions close at hand, while the center controls are arranged for quick access instead of burying everyday functions behind multiple menus. A rearview camera adds useful visibility when backing, and keyless entry with push-button start makes daily use more convenient.  The RX also benefits from the solid road manners that helped build Lexuss reputation in the luxury crossover segment. Four-wheel disc brakes, stability control, traction control, antilock braking, multiple airbags, and all-wheel drive work together to support the driver in changing road conditions. The suspension is tuned to absorb rough pavement without making the vehicle feel disconnected, which is especially useful on longer Tampa-area drives.  At this mileage, the appeal is less about chasing the newest screen or the latest styling trend and more about getting a well-established luxury SUV with a proven layout, a smooth V6, useful AWD capability, and a comfortable cabin. The RX 350s combination of manageable size and genuine interior space has aged well because it was designed around the things drivers use every day rather than novelty. description: Two-owner. Accident-free history. AWD. Naturally aspirated SKYACTIV power. This 2014 Mazda CX-5 Touring AWD delivers the versatility of a compact SUV with something Mazda has always done particularly well: making practical vehicles genuinely enjoyable to drive.  With 125,350 miles, this isn't being presented as a low-mileage SUV. The appeal is getting a well-equipped, accident-free AWD crossover with a straightforward drivetrain and the everyday practicality that made the CX-5 such a strong alternative to the CR-V and RAV4.  Finished in Jet Black Mica over a Sand cloth interior, this Touring has a clean, understated look, while 17-inch aluminum alloy wheels give it a more finished appearance than the typical base-model crossover.  Under the hood is Mazda's naturally aspirated 2.5-liter SKYACTIV four-cylinder paired with a traditional 6-speed automatic transmission and AWD.  No small turbocharged engine. No CVT. Just a naturally aspirated four-cylinder and conventional geared automatic.  That's an appealing combination for someone shopping for a straightforward used SUV, and Mazda's chassis tuning gives the CX-5 a more responsive, connected personality than many vehicles in this class.  AWD makes it particularly well suited for the Pacific Northwest, adding confidence through rainy commutes, winter weather, mountain passes, and weekend trips into the Cascades. At the same time, an EPA-estimated 24 MPG city and 30 MPG highway keeps it reasonable to operate as an everyday vehicle.  The Touring trim adds the comfort and convenience features that matter most.  Sport-shaped front seats, a power driver's seat, air conditioning, remote keyless entry, cruise control, Bluetooth hands-free connectivity, steering wheel-mounted audio controls, and a rearview camera make this CX-5 comfortable and easy to live with.  The six-speaker AM/FM/CD/HD audio system handles entertainment, while the split between passenger room and rear cargo space gives you the flexibility expected from a compact SUV. Groceries, luggage, outdoor equipment, pets, or weekend projects are all easier to accommodate than they would be in a traditional sedan.  The CX-5 also earned strong recognition when new, including IIHS safety honors and a Kelley Blue Book 5-Year Cost to Own Award, reflecting the combination of practicality and ownership value that helped establish the CX-5 as one of Mazda's most important vehicles.  At this mileage, history matters, and a two-owner, accident-free vehicle history gives this Mazda a story worth considering.  Offered by Honda of Kirkland, backed by more than 30 years of serving the greater Seattle and Kirkland communities.
